name: fc
exec: (()=>{const T=window.THREE,S=window.__app.scene;const out={};const grab=n=>{let m=null;S.traverse(o=>{if(o.name==='main:'+n)m=o;});if(!m)return null;m.updateWorldMatrix(true,false);const p=m.geometry.attributes.position;const v=new T.Vector3();let r={x:[1e9,-1e9],y:[1e9,-1e9],z:[1e9,-1e9]};for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++){v.fromBufferAttribute(p,i).applyMatrix4(m.matrixWorld);r.x[0]=Math.min(r.x[0],v.x);r.x[1]=Math.max(r.x[1],v.x);r.y[0]=Math.min(r.y[0],v.y);r.y[1]=Math.max(r.y[1],v.y);r.z[0]=Math.min(r.z[0],v.z);r.z[1]=Math.max(r.z[1],v.z);}return {x:r.x.map(f=>+f.toFixed(1)),y:r.y.map(f=>+f.toFixed(1)),z:r.z.map(f=>+f.toFixed(1))};};for(const n of ['tileRed','classroomFloor','deskTop','interiorPlaster','chalkboard'])out[n]=grab(n);return JSON.stringify(out)})()
